p: DELLA Motto Series 9100 BTU 20.5 SEER2 Mini Split Heat Pump AC - Up to 400 Sq.Ft.
x: This is my fifth Della mini split.  We installed it in an off grid cabin.  It runs off 8 - 450w solar panels, 3000w EG4 inverter, and 10kw of server rack batteries.  When in ac mode it was pulling around 300w and in heat mode it was pulling around 1200w.  They are simple to install if you have all the right tools.  Vacuum pump, gauges, and a open ended torque wrench are a must!
